bio.achievements: Successfully led initiatives that supported the education and well-being of underprivileged girl students through bicycle distribution, financial assistance, and access to digital learning resources. Fostered strong teamwork and community participation to maximize the impact of the club's service activities.
bio.projects:
• Bicycle Distribution Drive for underprivileged girl students.
• Financial aid to support students' education.
• Donation of educational learning apps to promote digital education and equal learning opportunities.
bio.milestones: Strengthened the club's commitment to educational empowerment by successfully implementing multiple student-focused service projects, expanding access to education through both physical support and digital learning initiatives.

bio.achievements: The Rotary year 2024–25 has been a truly fulfilling journey of service, compassion, and fellowship. Together, we successfully completed more than 45 impactful projects that touched countless lives across healthcare, education, environmental conservation, youth development, and community welfare. Our initiatives not only addressed immediate community needs but also created opportunities for long-term growth and empowerment. Every achievement this year stands as a testament to the unwavering commitment, teamwork, and dedication of our members, who continued to uphold the Rotary motto, "Service Above Self."
bio.projects:
• Mega Medical & Surgery Camp at Utawali Tribal Area
• Blood Donation Camp at Meghe College
• Mental Health Awareness Programs at Government ITI and Vidyabharati College
• Pregnancy Belt Distribution at Government Hospital
• Books Donation Drive for HIV/AIDS-affected Students
• Tree Plantation and Forest Cleanliness Drive
• Toilet Construction at ZP School
• Donation of Educational Materials to Schools in Melghat
• Road Safety Awareness Week with RTO
• Mammography Screening Camp and Women's Health Initiatives
• Panpoi Project – Installation of Five Public Drinking Water Stations
• Chartering of a New Rotaract Club for Youth Development
bio.milestones: As we reflect on this remarkable Rotary year, we take pride in the milestones we have achieved together. We strengthened our partnerships with educational institutions, healthcare professionals, government departments, and community organizations, enabling us to expand the reach and impact of our service initiatives. Increased member participation, the successful execution of diverse community projects, and the formation of a new Rotaract Club have further strengthened our foundation for the future. These milestones are not merely accomplishments but stepping stones toward building a stronger, more compassionate community through Rotary service.

bio.achievements: During the Rotary year, our club remained committed to improving community healthcare through impactful medical initiatives. We successfully organized free surgeries, diagnostic camps, women's health awareness programs, and specialized medical camps in remote and underserved areas. Through sustained efforts in health education and preventive care, we positively impacted countless lives while promoting accessible and affordable healthcare for all.
bio.projects:
• Free Surgeries at Gore Medical College
• Sanitary Pad Usage Awareness Program in Backward Areas
• Diagnostic Camps at Various Locations
• Cancer and Multi-specialty Surgery Camp at Utavali, Melghat
• Street Play (Nukkad Natak) during Ganeshotsav for Women's Rights Awareness
• Health Camps in Collaboration with Obstetricians and Gynecologists Association
bio.milestones: The year marked significant progress in expanding healthcare services to rural and underserved communities. Large-scale medical camps, awareness drives on menstrual hygiene and women's rights, and collaborative initiatives with healthcare professionals strengthened our outreach and reinforced our commitment to preventive healthcare, women's empowerment, and quality medical services for those in need.
